conditions.evidence: prior to the development of prediabetes
conditions.label: prediabetes

modalities.evidence: heart rate, accelerometry, and electrodermal conductance
Blood was collected during the study for measurement of glucose, hemoglobin A1C, lipoproteins, and triglycerides

output.population: subjects aged 35-65 years, inclusive, including only post-menopausal females, with a point of care A1C measurement between 5.2-6.4%
output.summary: Continuous glucose monitor readings and wrist-worn wearable sensor data collected over 10 days, with blood measurements and an oral glucose tolerance test, to study wearable detection of early physiological changes before prediabetes.
